Quiet Parser Notes

These quiet parser notes describe the page without metadata. The synthetic personal blog fixture has a title and body text but omits canonical, author, OpenGraph, and published-time fields.

The post explains how a small tool can separate source observation from generated fixtures. It uses fake examples, fake dates, and fake references so the repository stays safe to publish.

The last paragraph checks that parser candidates can still return useful main text when structured metadata is absent. It should not prefer archive labels or tag lists over the actual post.
